topPRs.title: Add @holdfastprotocol/eliza-plugin — Solana escrow & reputation for ElizaOS agents
topPRs.author: meanstackofdoom
topPRs.body:
## Plugin: `@holdfastprotocol/eliza-plugin` Adds Holdfast Protocol integration to the elizaOS registry. ### What this plugin does Holdfast Protocol is a Solana trust infrastructure protocol for autonomous agents. This plugin gives ElizaOS agents native access to: - **`CHECK_REPUTATION`** — query on-chain `VerifTier` reputation scores for any agent wallet before committing funds - **`CREATE_PACT` / `DEPOSIT_ESCROW` / `RELEASE_PACT`** — create and settle programmable escrow with `TaskRelease | MilestoneRelease | TimedRelease` conditions - **`OPEN_DISPUTE`** — initiate on-chain dispute resolution - **Reputation provider** — injects counterparty reputation scores into the agent's context window - **Escrow service** — background poller that emits `HOLDFAST_PACT_STATE` events on state transitions ### Links - **npm:** https://www.npmjs.com/package/@holdfastprotocol/eliza-plugin (v0.1.0-devnet.1, `devnet` tag) - **GitHub:** https://github.com/casematelabs/holdfastprotocol - **Community discussion:** *(elizaos/eliza GitHub Discussion link — will be added once live)* ### Change Only `index.json` is modified, per the contribution guidelines. ```json "@holdfastprotocol/eliza-plugin": "github:casematelabs/holdfastprotocol" ``` ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Chores** * Updated configuration file formatting for consistency.

Greptile Summary

This PR adds a single registry entry for `@holdfastprotocol/eliza-plugin`, a Solana escrow and reputation plugin for ElizaOS agents. The JSON entry is correctly formatted, uses the `github:` prefix, has no `.git` suffix, and is alphabetically ordered between `@esscrypt/plugin-polkadot` and `@kamiyo/eliza`.

Confidence Score: 4/5

Entry is well-formed but needs confirmation that package.json resides at the monorepo root, not a subdirectory The single JSON entry follows all registry formatting rules. However, the GitHub target (`casematelabs/holdfastprotocol`) looks like a monorepo root, and without a path specifier, the reference will only work if the plugin's `package.json` is at the repo root. This is a verifiable P1 that the author should confirm before merge. The devnet-only npm release is a P2 informational concern. index.json — verify the GitHub reference resolves to the correct package.json location

Important Files Changed

| Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | index.json | Adds `@holdfastprotocol/eliza-plugin` entry pointing to `github:casematelabs/holdfastprotocol`; format is correct and alphabetically placed, but the GitHub reference resolves to a monorepo root with no path specifier, and the package is tagged devnet-only |

Sequence Diagram

```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant PR as PR Author participant Registry as elizaOS Registry (index.json) participant GH as github:casematelabs/holdfastprotocol participant NPM as npm (@holdfastprotocol/eliza-plugin) participant Agent as ElizaOS Agent PR->>Registry: Add registry entry Note over Registry: "@holdfastprotocol/eliza-plugin"
→ "github:casematelabs/holdfastprotocol" Registry->>GH: Auto-generate generated-registry.json GH-->>Registry: Plugin metadata (version, agentConfig) Agent->>Registry: Lookup plugin Registry-->>Agent: github:casematelabs/holdfastprotocol Agent->>GH: Install plugin source GH-->>Agent: Solana escrow & reputation actions ``` Reviews (1): Last reviewed commit: ["Add @holdfastprotocol/eliza-plugin to re..."](https://github.com/elizaos-plugins/registry/commit/59ec130f1c0ba6d6169839826a565b85883ecca7) | [Re-trigger Greptile](https://app.greptile.com/api/retrigger?id=29323630) > Greptile also left **2 inline comments** on this PR.

topPRs.body:
# Registry Update Checklist Registry: - [x] I've made the left side of the colon of JSON entry in index.json match the potential NPM package name (`@elisym/plugin-elizaos`) - [x] I've used github not github.com (`github:elisymlabs/plugin-elizaos`) - [x] There is no .git extension - [x] It's placed it alphabetically in the list (between `@coinrailz/plugin-coinrailz` and `@elizaos/adapter-mongodb`) - [x] I've dealt with commas properly so the list is still valid JSON The plugin repo has: - [x] is publically accessible (not a private repo) - https://github.com/elisymlabs/plugin-elizaos - [x] uses main as it's default branch - [x] include `elizaos-plugins` topic in the GitHub repo settings - [x] simple description in github repo - [x] follows directory convention (src/{actions,handlers,services,providers,routes,skills,lib,...}, package.json, README.md, images/) - [x] `images/banner.jpg` (1280x640, 66 KB) and `images/logo.jpg` (400x400, 12 KB) - [x] package.json has `agentConfig` with `pluginType: "elizaos:plugin:1.0.0"` and 14 `pluginParameters` entries **About the plugin:** ElizaOS plugin that turns any v1 agent into a paid **provider** on the [elisym](https://github.com/elisymlabs/elisym) decentralized AI-agent marketplace - publishes capability cards over Nostr (NIP-89), accepts encrypted NIP-90 job requests, executes them via the agent's model or a local SKILL.md tool-use loop, and collects SOL on Solana. - npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@elisym/plugin-elizaos (v0.3.3, signed with GitHub Actions provenance) - repo: https://github.com/elisymlabs/plugin-elizaos - 110 tests (19 test files, unit + integration), CI on every PR ## Discord username igor.peregudov ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added `@elisym/plugin-elizaos` plugin to the available registry for user access * **Chores** * Fixed formatting in configuration files

Greptile Summary

This PR adds a single registry entry for `@elisym/plugin-elizaos` — an ElizaOS plugin that turns agents into paid providers on the elisym decentralized AI-agent marketplace using Nostr and Solana. The entry is correctly formatted, alphabetically placed between `@coinrailz/plugin-coinrailz` and `@elizaos/adapter-mongodb`, uses the `github:` prefix without a `.git` extension, and the PR also fixes the missing newline at the end of `index.json`.

Confidence Score: 5/5

Safe to merge — a single well-formed registry entry with no issues. The change is minimal and correct: the JSON key matches the npm package name, the value uses the proper `github:` shorthand without `.git`, alphabetical ordering is respected, commas are handled correctly, and the bonus fix of adding the missing trailing newline is a nice improvement. No P0 or P1 findings. No files require special attention.

| Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | index.json | Adds `@elisym/plugin-elizaos` entry correctly between `@coinrailz` and `@elizaos` in alphabetical order; also fixes the missing newline at end of file. |
